original_ai_output.title_zh: 国际刑事法院裁定中非共和国前叛军指挥官犯有危害人类罪
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 国际刑事法院周三裁定中非共和国前民兵指挥官马哈马特·赛义德·阿卜杜勒·卡尼犯有酷刑和非法拘禁等四项危害人类罪。赛义德被指在2013年中非内战期间掌管首都班吉一处以残酷条件闻名的拘留中心。法院将在稍后宣判刑期，同时裁定其三项战争罪指控不成立。

location.site: 打击盗匪中央办公室（OCRB）拘留中心
location.raw_text: the Central Office for the Repression of Banditry (OCRB) detention centre in the capital Bangui

key_facts.fact: 国际刑事法院裁定中非共和国前民兵指挥官马哈马特·赛义德·阿卜杜勒·卡尼犯有四项危害人类罪，包括酷刑和非法拘禁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The International Criminal Court on Wednesday convicted former Central African Republic rebel commander Mahamat Said Abdel Kani on four counts of crimes against humanity including torture and unlawful imprisonment.

key_facts.fact: 赛义德被指掌管首都班吉的OCRB拘留中心，囚犯遭受酷刑和恶劣待遇
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Said ran the Central Office for the Repression of Banditry (OCRB) detention centre in the capital Bangui where horrific acts of torture and deprivation were inflicted on prisoners.

key_facts.fact: 法院将在稍后宣判刑期，赛义德三项战争罪指控被裁定不成立
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The ICC will deliver a sentence for the crimes at a later date. Said was also acquitted of three counts of war crimes.

key_facts.fact: 赛义德现年56岁，曾任主要穆斯林塞雷卡叛军组织高级指挥官
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Said was a top commander of the mainly Muslim Seleka rebel group that ousted president François Bozize

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源（France 24），尚缺乏交叉验证
赛义德的具体刑期尚未确定
